name: [🔮] 2omething evil will happen
desc:
You just can't shake the feeling that something evil will happen.

something evil will happen is a disaster-survival game heavily inspired by classic games in the same genre. 

🌩️ DISASTERS - Each round, a randomly chosen disaster will accompany opposing players in trying to take you down!
💣 GEAR - Earn Dosh to purchase Gear! Sabotage your opponents, keep yourself alive, or save others from their demise!
☀️ GLORY -  Use your skills to fight and survive, building Heat throughout the round. The more Heat you have, the more Glory you earn!
